name: [x]it! in Markdown
comment: Highlights ```xit fenced code blocks inside Markdown. This is jotaen's own suggestion for writing [x]it! inside another document, from Discussion #10, the most-upvoted open request on the format: "another approach would be to make use of embedded code blocks". The rule is modelled on the fenced_code_block_* rules in VS Code's own markdown grammar rather than written from scratch, because the details are load-bearing: `(^|\G)` anchors each line, the backreferences to groups 2 and 3 close the block on a fence of the same character and the same indentation, and the inner begin/while rule is what keeps the embedded language from swallowing the closing fence.
